intervals.label: collaboration active
intervals.note: Span from the GNO collaboration's final paper (gallium observations at LNGS lasted from May 14, 1991 through April 9, 2003); stored at year/month precision.
intervals.quote: gallium based solar observations at LNGS (first in GALLEX, later in GNO) lasted from May 14, 1991 through April 9, 2003

intervals.label: collaboration completed
intervals.note: Terminal event from the GNO collaboration's final paper (GNO terminated after solar runs performed between May 20, 1998 and April 9, 2003); stored at month precision.
intervals.quote: The GNO experiment is now terminated after altogether 58 solar exposure runs that were performed between May 20, 1998 and April 9, 2003.

country_count.locator: GNO Collaboration, Phys. Lett. B 616 (2005) 174 (arXiv:hep-ex/0504037), author affiliations a-l; T. Kirsten, The GALLEX Project (1990), p. 187, GALLEX collaboration list
country_count.note: Derived as the union of the countries of the collaboration's institutions in two papers. The GNO final paper's affiliations (the quote) are in Germany, Italy, France and Poland. The 1990 GALLEX collaboration list adds the Weizmann Institute, Rehovot (Israel) and Brookhaven National Laboratory, Upton, N.Y. (United States). Neither paper states a country count. The GNO-era list alone has four countries and the 1990 GALLEX list five (Poland does not appear in it).
country_count.quote: D-69029 Heidelberg, Germany ... I-67010 l'Aquila, Italy ... F-91191 Gif-sur-Yvette Cedex, France ... PL-30059 Krakow, Poland

name: GALLEX/GNO Collaboration
notes: No member count or complete institution list was found in a source consulted (the 2026-09-17 search found no official collaboration page); the six countries are tallied from the institutions named in two collaboration papers.

summary.plain: The international team, from institutions in Germany, Italy, France, Israel, Poland and the United States, that ran the GALLEX and GNO gallium solar-neutrino experiments in Italy.
summary.technical: International collaboration of institutions in Germany, Italy, France, Israel, Poland and the United States (the GNO-era author list has Germany, Italy, France and Poland; the 1990 GALLEX list has Germany, Italy, France, Israel and the United States), operating GALLEX (1991-1997) and its successor GNO (1998-2003) at LNGS.
